meta.aciklama: GitHub Repo turns vibe-coding agents into senior engineers.  Comment ‘Skills’ for the link.

transkript.t: This new GitHub repo just dropped that turns vibe coding AI agents into actual senior engineers.
It's called skills and the way it does it is that instead of giving the agent vague prompts,
it gives it a small composable skill that force proper engineering processes,
grilling you on the plan first, making you write the specs,
doing the TDD and diagnosing the bugs the right way.
The repo already has over 313,000 stars on GitHub and works with all your CLI tools.
The best part? It's free and open source. Here's the link, but if you want it in the DMs, comment skills.
